text:
sarah_support: FYI BrightArc is seeing repeated p95 token latency spikes and intermittent 429s on their Dedicated EU2 pool since ~08:15 UTC. They say retries spiked too and billing jumped. Escalating for triage.
customer_brightarc: Seeing bursts where a request that usually returns in 60-80ms jumps to 700-1200ms then 429s. Autoscale seemed to kick but spikes continued. We can repro on demand.

mike_oncall: Can you paste pool/node IDs + model + a small sample of the request IDs? Need to pull nvml metrics. Also, did they change model variant or quantization recently?

sarah_support: pool_id `eu2-dedicated-7`, node `node-7c3b`, model `rw-large-v2:2025-02-18`. Sample req IDs: `req_9142`, `req_9143`, `req_9150`. Attached snippet of their trace: ``query_id=req_9150 latency_tokens=[50,120,900,65] status=200 then retry->429``. No config changes on their side.

jenna_eng: quick hypothesis: noisy-neighbor in MIG slices causing SM saturation / L3 cache thrash leading to token-level jitter. If another tenant has a heavy kernel burst it can stall slices even if overall node util looks ok.

jenna_eng: Can we get `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` + `nvml` sample around spikes and `dmesg` for any GPU ECC/thermal events? Also check MIG slice allocations on `node-7c3b` (some tenants still using 1g.5gb small slices).

sarah_support: grabbing nvml logs now, will paste shortly. In the meantime BrightArc asked if we can temporarily isolate them to a single MIG slice to confirm.

infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled pool `eu2-dedicated-7` +1 node at 08:32:12 UTC (reason: p95 latency > threshold).

mike_oncall: autoscaler note: it scaled after sustained queue-depth, but token-level spikes are short and didn't meet window for early scale. Config uses `autoscale.window_ms=600000` and `autoscale.q_ps_threshold=20`. That explains delayed reaction.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) move BrightArc to an isolated slice on a spare node, 2) adjust autoscale window/threshold to be more sensitive for this pool, 3) temporarily pin them to a lower-concurrency config to reduce token amplification from retries.

sarah_support: BrightArc accepted option 1. Can we do a quick tenant move? They want to avoid a full redeploy.

jenna_eng: I'll run the migration to an isolated slice and enable temporary Cgroup cap. Command I'll use: ``redwood admin assign-tenant --tenant brightarc --pool eu2-dedicated-7 --isolate true --migrate-now``. After migration we'll run a synthetic 200 rps burst to try to repro.

jenna_eng: Also gathering `nvidia-smi dmon` and `perf` during the burst. If we reproduce, plan is to file a cross-slice interference bug and propose the scheduler change: avoid packing high-variance workloads into slices on the same physical GPU and add an L3-aware placement heuristic.

sarah_support: Also requested billing protection—can we mark retry tokens between 08:15-08:45 for credit?

jenna_eng: Yes ops: we'll create a billing credit ticket for the spike window and note it's correlated with noisy-neighbor. I'll cc finance.

infra-bot: migration job `mig-move-2983` started at 08:44:03 UTC; estimated ETA ~12m.

customer_brightarc: Thanks — appreciate quick response. We'll hold on pushing new traffic until you confirm isolation. :pray:

mike_oncall: After isolation, please keep an eye on p99 as well. If stable, we'll revert autoscale window changes. If not, we'll do a deeper kernel-level trace.

jenna_eng: Update: migration completed at 08:56:11 UTC, isolated slice on `node-9f2a` assigned. Running synthetic burst now. Collecting `nvidia-smi dmon` logs and tracer.

jenna_eng: Preliminary: isolated slice shows stable token latencies ~70-90ms during 200rps burst. Original node (node-7c3b) shows correlated SM utilization spikes on neighbor slices and L3 hit-rate drops. Saving logs.

sarah_support: Shared this with BrightArc; they're rerunning their real workload for confirmation.

customer_brightarc: After migration our p95 dropped back to baseline. No more 429s so far. Thank you! :tada:

jenna_eng: Closing loop: we'll open an infra bug for MIG packing heuristic + autoscale tuning task. Finance: will issue a credit for retries in the 08:15–08:45 window. Follow-ups: schedule a deeper run to gather perf traces next week.

sarah_support: Closing the escalation on our side, moving to postmortem and action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
